items.name: LinearDisplay
items.description: LinearDisplay.pl is a program that generates publication quality linear maps of user-defined genetic features (e.g., ORFs, promoters, transcriptional terminators, restriction enzyme recognition sites, primer-binding sites, phage attachment sites, target site duplications, assembly/contig breaks and RNA structures). It can also depict circular clusters like those used in network diagrams.
